versions.changelog:
- No user-facing changes in this release.
- Version number updated to 1.0.1; documentation and features remain unchanged.

Initial release of chinese-toolkit skill for OpenClaw:

- Provides comprehensive Chinese text processing, translation, OCR, and speech recognition capabilities.
- Supports key features such as Chinese word segmentation, pinyin conversion, keyword extraction, sentiment analysis, text classification, and error correction.
- Integrates multiple translation APIs (Baidu, Google, Tencent) and supports both API and local model operation.
- Enables Chinese OCR for images, PDFs, handwriting, and tables, as well as speech-to-text and text-to-speech functionalities.
- Includes performance optimizations, caching, parallel processing, and robust security/privacy measures.
- Offers detailed documentation, usage examples, troubleshooting guidance, and community contribution guidelines.
